My mom and I dont have a good relationship at all, ever since I've moved in with my boyfriend it's gotten better. But not really. Today, I am going to my school to get pictures for the virtual graduation next month, and I want my flute with me. My flute is my everything. Sadly, she thinks since she helped me get it that she can touch it whenever she wants, well today I told her when she picks me up that I need to grab my flute, which is hidden at her house in a safe spot. Now, she won't stop calling me and texting me demanding to tell her where it is and that "I got it for you, I can touch it whenever I want." she thinks I'm disrespectful for not letting her touch my very delicate and expensive instrument. AITA?
